[Autotest] Improvements to touch_UpdateErrors test Make touch_UpdateErrors check that the correct device id checks for update. In this vein, redo the code in input_playback where the hw_id is found, to fix the exceptions of sumo and lulu. Now, the test will fail if a device with both a touchscreen and touchpad skipped checking for updates on only one of them. Also identify the boards with problematic FSI builds. These boards, such as expresso, have failures updating to their FSI firmware - a problem we cannot fix. Only check the most recent build's logs for these devices. Remove the hack that was there before. All other devices behave the same way. Now, the test will fail if, on one of the exception boards, there is both a failure in the FSI build present and a failure on the most recent build. Modify touch_WakeupSource to split invalid boards into invalid touchpads and invalid touchscreens. Now, test will not fail on sumo. BUG=None TEST=ran affected tests on several devices Change-Id: I697522f2c9992990a2d2adb0bb997a09fed5d4c7 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/310312 Commit-Ready: Katherine Threlkeld <kathrelkeld@google.com> Tested-by: Katherine Threlkeld <kathrelkeld@google.com> Reviewed-by: David Haddock <dhaddock@chromium.org>

cros_generate_update_payload: Fix "cmp" command evaluation linter error. The construction "if $(cmp ...);" will execute "cmp ..." and then the output of the cmp command and evaluate the "if" condition based on the exit code of that output execution. Since cmp doesn't print any output in either case, the execution of its output doesn't actually execute anything and the "if" uses the last exit code (from the cmp command itself). While this works, it is incorrect. This patch fixes the linter warning by remoing the $(). BUG=None TEST=linter. Change-Id: I1a2c97fb2f3633ea33477acd755087aa5063eb41 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/311107 Commit-Ready: Alex Deymo <deymo@chromium.org> Tested-by: Alex Deymo <deymo@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Jason Kusuma <jkusuma@chromium.org>
